capture.setup: the existing local kind cluster `openmap` (OpenMap Helm release in namespace openmap, CoreDNS, kindnet, local-path-provisioner); read-only use
capture.command: apps/collectors/cmd/kubernetes invoked with target http://127.0.0.1:19643 (proxy -> API server https://127.0.0.1:49366), options {clusterName: kind-openmap}; authenticated with a bound token of a temporary ServiceAccount `fxlab-reader` whose ClusterRole grants only get/list on namespaces, nodes, pods, services, deployments, statefulsets, daemonsets, replicasets and ingresses (no Secrets or ConfigMaps); the ServiceAccount, ClusterRole and binding were deleted after the capture and the token is not stored; recording HTTP proxy (throwaway lab tool, not checked in) between the collector and the container; it stores each response status, Content-Type/Server/ETag headers and the body bytes unchanged; request Authorization headers are forwarded and never stored

files.description: ordered list of the collector's API requests (/version, namespaces, nodes, deployments, statefulsets, daemonsets, replicasets, pods, services, ingresses) with status
